def snap(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
        d[(n['color'],r0,r1,c0,c1)]=n['pixels']
    return d
def keyobjs(f):
    o={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
        if n['color'] in 'NpY' and n['pixels']<=4:
            o.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((r0,r1,c0,c1))
        if n['color']=='b':
            o.setdefault('b',[]).append((r0,c0,c1))
    return o
